subject: Invoice float horizon & credit-trigger plan
messages:
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acme-energy.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: acct-pay@acme-energy.com
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot payment cadence and VAT routing for EU entity

Marcus —

Thanks for the great demo last week. Our procurement team asked me to confirm payment cadence for the 3-month pilot before we share final PO. Two requests from our side:

1) Given internal approval timelines we need a 60-day invoice float for the first two invoices (Net60) so cash flows line up with our month-end cycles. After the pilot we can move to standard Net30 or Net45 depending on consumption.
2) VAT: we need invoices to reference our NL legal entity (ACME Energy Netherlands B.V.) and include our VAT ID so we can reclaim.

Do you have a standard amendment for temporary extended terms, and do you support staged settlement (partial invoicing) tied to usage thresholds?

Attachments: none

Best,
Sofia Alvarez
Head of Procurement, ACME Energy
sofia.alvarez@acme-energy.com
+44 20 5555 1212

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acme-energy.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot payment cadence and VAT routing for EU entity

Sofia —

Appreciate the clarity. We can support a temporary extended float and staged settlement; below is a pragmatic proposal to balance your cash needs and our credit exposure: 

- Temporary float horizon: Accept Net60 for the first two invoices of the pilot (covering month 0 and month 1 usage).
- Credit threshold / trigger: We’ll provision a temporary credit limit of $150,000 for the pilot period. If usage exceeds $100k/mo for two consecutive months, the account automatically converts to Net30 and we increase the limit to $300,000 (subject to quick underwriting).
- Staged settlement: We can invoice on a 60/40 split for each pilot invoice (60% upon issuance, 40% due within 45 days) OR invoice full amount on Net60 — open to whichever aligns with ACME’s internal processing.
- VAT routing: We will list ACME Energy Netherlands B.V. as the billing entity when you confirm the VAT ID and legal address; Rachel will confirm format requirements for VAT reclaim lines.

I’ve attached a draft schedule that shows both options (split vs full Net60). If this looks acceptable I’ll have Ben push a short amendment for signature and Rachel will prepare the invoice templates with the correct VAT fields.

Attachments: proposal_invoice_schedule.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Partnerships — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acme-energy.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot payment cadence and VAT routing for EU entity

Hi Sofia / Marcus —

Quick note from billing: below are the two concrete invoice templates we can produce immediately once you confirm VAT details. I included expected due dates assuming invoice issued on the 1st of the month.

Option A — Full Net60 (Invoice issued 2026-10-01)
- Invoice #1 issued 2026-10-01, due 2026-11-30 (Net60)
- Invoice #2 issued 2026-11-01, due 2026-12-31 (Net60)

Option B — Staged settlement (60/40 split)
- Invoice #1a (60%) issued 2026-10-01, due 2026-11-30
- Invoice #1b (40%) issued 2026-10-01, due 2026-12-15 (Net75 for the remainder)

Credit terms: temporary credit limit $150,000 applied on 2026-10-01; we will run usage checks after month one.

VAT requirements: please provide: registered company name, VAT ID, and address for the Netherlands entity. For EU reclaim we will include the VAT ID on the invoice header and add a reverse-charge note if applicable to the transaction.

I’ve attached the invoice schedule spreadsheet so you can confirm which option you prefer and where to place the VAT fields.

Attachments: 2026-09-29-invoice_schedule.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Billing Manager — Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com

From: acct-pay@acme-energy.com
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acme-energy.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot payment cadence and VAT routing for EU entity

Rachel / Marcus —

Thanks for the options. ACME AP can accept Option A (Full Net60 for first two invoices) but we would like two concessions before signature: 

1) Please cap the pilot credit limit at $100,000 rather than $150,000 — lower internal exposure.
2) Confirm that invoices will show "ACME Energy Netherlands B.V., VAT NL123456789" exactly in the billing header so our reclaim team can route automatically.

Also — if Redwood can offer a 1.5% early-payment discount for any invoices paid on Net30 during the pilot, that would make it easier for us to move some payments earlier.

Please confirm and share the short amendment for signature.

Regards,
ACME Accounts Payable
acct-pay@acme-energy.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: acct-pay@acme-energy.com, Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acme-energy.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot payment cadence and VAT routing for EU entity

ACME team —

Appreciate the counter. We can accept Net60 for the first two invoices with the following final terms: 

- Pilot credit limit: $100,000 (as requested)
- Net60 applies for invoice 1 and invoice 2 only; after month 2, account will move to Net30 if usage > $100k/mo for two consecutive months.
- Early pay discount: 1.0% for payments received within Net30 during the pilot (we’re agreeing to 1.0% vs 1.5%).
- VAT: we will include exactly "ACME Energy Netherlands B.V., VAT NL123456789" on the invoice header once you confirm the legal address.

I’ve attached a short amendment for signature and a DocuSign link to expedite execution. Once signed, Rachel will issue the first invoice per the agreed schedule.

Attachments: amendment-netterms-docusign.pdf
DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/r/ABC123456789

Let me know if you need any edits — otherwise we’ll send the DocuSign envelope this afternoon.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
